authorization: Requested browser verification of the identified test.env application; existing credentials only; no authentication configuration or business writes.
credentialPolicy: Read ignored ENV as literal data; never export credentials, cookies or session URLs; disable Remember username.
evidence: whole-host token interval with accounting limits
limits: Existing shell and session controls only; use separately authorized deployed fixtures for CRUD/Composer.
UI action wall time includes host-control overhead; no browser navigation performance claim.
APEX 26.2 requires a separate extension and results.

cases.title: Authorized login
steps: Open the verified application URL in the host browser.
Fill Username and Password from test.env; disable Remember username; submit.
expected: Authenticated Home shows the original application title.

cases.title: Authenticated reload
steps: Reload Home and wait for its heading.
expected: Session persists and original title remains visible.

cases.title: Navigation disclosure
expected: Navigation opens and the Home entry is present.

cases.title: Keyboard navigation control
steps: Press Enter on the focused Main Navigation button.
expected: The disclosure closes; keyboard operation succeeds.

cases.title: Narrow shell
steps: Record effective DOM width, inspect controls and horizontal overflow; save screenshot.
expected: Original title and navigation/account controls render without document horizontal overflow.
Report actual effective width; do not claim an exact breakpoint if the panel constrains it.

cases.title: Sign out
steps: Open the account menu and select Sign Out.

cases.title: Protected Home after logout
steps: Navigate directly to the verified Home URL without a session parameter.
expected: Login is required and authenticated content is not displayed.

cases.title: Empty login rejection
steps: Submit empty Username and Password; wait for the resulting error.
expected: Invalid Login Credentials appears and Home remains inaccessible.

cases.title: Login after rejection
steps: Use valid ENV credentials again with Remember username disabled.
